method: 7 triaged rows from stardust/dynamic-features.md (extract --dynamics detector + 2 manual motion rows); chrome interaction verified by motion-observe on the published origin against the live observation + a direct hover probe; tags gated by consent-gate on the preview host

features.verifiedBy: nothing on the page reads the object; it only carries GA4 config, which is not loaded on the preview host (see consent-gate)

features.owner: none needed: single page, single language; the replica emits no hreflang alternates
decide whether the beacon is re-enabled on the launch host (it is bound to the Cloudflare zone of the source domain)
confirm the GA4 property id for launch; the tag is not loaded on the preview host so preview traffic never reaches the production property
same decision as the gtag loader; the helper scripts only push events to gtag

features.feature: Hamburger menu drawer (.nmh-menu-btn → .nmh-menu.open + .nmh-overlay, close button, Escape)
features.verifiedBy: motion-observe on the published origin vs live: class open added 2x on both, class show added 2x on both, transitions opacity/transform/visibility 200ms parity; direct probe: drawer opens on .nmh-menu-btn and closes on .nmh-menu-close (overlayOpen false, menuOpen false after close); footer link hover colour rgb(107,95,71) → rgb(44,37,25) on both sides; residual: live has a 180ms colour transition on footer links, build changes instantly

features.feature: body entrance fade (nm-page-in .42s, disabled under reduced motion)
features.verifiedBy: styles.css: body.appear { animation: nm-page-in 0.42s ease both } + prefers-reduced-motion override; motion-observe published: 0 animations sampled post-settle on both sides (the fade completes before the first frame)
